plain_english: Joined in enjoyment by mere touch-contact of Your lotus-feet — bring me, Lord, by the neck into Your house.
sanskrit_cite: tvatpādapadmasamparkamātrasambhogasaṅginam | galepādikayā nātha māṃ svaveśma praveśaya

plain_english: Head hair dyed by Your foot-lotus-dust-redness — when shall I frantically begin to dance?
sanskrit_cite: bhavatpādāmbujarajorājirañjitamūrdhajaḥ | apārarabhasārabdhanartanaḥ syām ahaṃ kadā

plain_english: You, sole Lord — this alone I always ask: dwelling inside You, may I be silent; not otherwise, O Wise One.
sanskrit_cite: tvad ekanātho bhagavann iyad evārthaye sadā | tvadantarvasatir mūko bhaveyaṃ mānyathā budhaḥ

plain_english: Ah nectar-ocean master! Ah sweet three-eyed One! Ah tasty deformed-eyed One! — thus may I dance, shouting.
sanskrit_cite: aho sudhānidhe svāminn aho mṛṣṭa trilocana | aho svādo virūpakṣety eva nṛtyeyam āraṭan

plain_english: Eyes half-closed by Your foot-lotus-touch — may I expand, reeling drunk on Your devotion-liquor-madness.
sanskrit_cite: tvatpādapadmasaṃsparśaparimīlitalocanaḥ | vijṛmbheyabhavadbhaktimadirāmadaghūrṇitaḥ

plain_english: May I dwell anywhere, O All-pervading, mind-mountain on earth, where that practice is — uninterrupted, great-rasa, made of Your prattle.
sanskrit_cite: cittabhūbhṛd bhuvi vibho vaseyaṃ kvāpi yatra sā | nirantaratvatpralāpamayī vṛttir mahārasā

plain_english: Where You stand with the Goddess, many-formed, from palace to gate-tower — in that city may I dwell.
sanskrit_cite: yatra devīsametas tvam āsaudhādā ca gopurāt | bahurūpaḥ sthitas tasmin vāstavyaḥ syām ahaṃ pure

plain_english: May Your sun-rays rejoice, Lord, until my heart-lotus blooms — for Your worship.
sanskrit_cite: samullasantu bhagavan bhavadbhānumarīcayaḥ | vikasatveṣa yāvan me hṛtpadmaḥ pūjanāya te

plain_english: Favor me, Lord, so that my mind, fallen ever at Your feet, tasting this and that — may it melt, may it flow.
sanskrit_cite: prasīda bhagavan yena tvatpade patitaṃ sadā | mano me tattadāsvādya kṣīved iva galed iva

plain_english: Whether from joy bursting pot-lids, or sorrow — from outside or inside feeling, appear to me, Lord.
sanskrit_cite: praharṣād vātha śokād vā yadi kuṅyād dhaṭād api | bāhyād athāntarād bhāvāt prakaṭībhava me prabho

plain_english: Outside too, inside too — may that ever-streaming, Your coolest foot-lotus-touch-nectar, be mine always.
sanskrit_cite: bahir apy antar api tat syandamānaṃ sadāstu me | bhavatpādāmbujasparśāmṛtam atyantaśītalam

plain_english: Plunging inside Your touch-nectar-lake — may that pleasure beyond all pleasures be mine always.
sanskrit_cite: tvatpādasaṃsparśasudhāsaraso 'ntarnimajjanam | ko 'py eṣa sarvasambhogalaṅghī bhogo 'stu me sadā

plain_english: Take what I offer — passion and the rest, Lord; make it nectar and eat it with devotees.
sanskrit_cite: niveditam upādatsva rāgādi bhagavan mayā | ādāya cāmṛtīkṛtya bhuṅkṣva bhaktajanaiḥ samam

plain_english: Ever-full on whole-world-food, happily seated — Master, cast Your grace-glance-moment on servants.
sanskrit_cite: aśeṣabhuvanāhāranityatṛptaḥ sukhāsanam | svāmin gṛhāṇa dāseṣu prasādālokanakṣaṇam

plain_english: Eyes half-closed, chewing inner devotion-wonder — "bow to me, to Śiva" — may I worship even straw.
sanskrit_cite: antarbhakticamatkāracarvaṇāmīlitekṣaṇaḥ | namo mahyaṃ śivāyeti pūjayam syāṃ tṛṇāny api

plain_english: Though I have gained Your being — seeing the world as my self-blaze — may I be unparted by devotion-rasa-enjoyments.
sanskrit_cite: api labdhabhavadbhāvaḥ svātmollāsamayaṃ jagat | paśyan bhaktirasābhogair bhaveyam aviyojitaḥ

plain_english: Since nothing else is to be desired, Lord — to You, the secondless, fullness is fitting.
sanskrit_cite: ākāmkṣaṇīyam aparaṃ yena nātha na vidyate | tava tenādvitīyasya yuktaṃ yat paripūrṇatā

plain_english: Where there is laughter, dancing, where passion-aversion are eaten, devotion-nectar drunk — may I reach that place.
sanskrit_cite: hasyate nṛtyate yatra rāgadveṣādi bhujyate | pīyate bhaktipīyūṣarasas tat prāpnuyāṃ padam

plain_english: May that unprecedented-joy-perfume of thought-flowers about You firm up in my mind — till bad-smell of bad-habit perishes.
sanskrit_cite: tat tad apūrvāmodatvaccintākusumavāsanā dṛḍhatām | etu mama manasi yāvann aśyatu durvāsanāgandhaḥ

plain_english: Where is love among passions, and where is loving at Hari's lotus-feet — thus teach my contradiction-loving heart what is good, O Deathless.
sanskrit_cite: kva nu rāgādiṣu rāgaḥ kva ca haracaraṇāmbujeṣu rāgitvam | itthaṃ virodharasikaṃ bodhaya hitam amara me hṛdayam

plain_english: Though wandering even through yogic states, though turned away from objects — may I be only heart-melted by Your-thought-liquor-madness.
sanskrit_cite: vicaran yogadaśāsv api viṣayavyāvṛttivartamāno 'pi | tvaccintāmadirāmadataralīkṛtahṛdaya eva syām

plain_english: In speech, mind-thoughts, body-gestures made by senses — everywhere, always, may bhakti-rasa go before me as leader.
sanskrit_cite: vāci manomatiṣu tathā śarīraceṣṭāsu karaṇaracitāsu | sarvatra sarvadā me puraḥsaro bhavatu bhaktirasaḥ

plain_english: While Your name "Śiva Śiva Śiva" is chanted endlessly, Lord — may I taste some great unrepeatable rasa.
sanskrit_cite: śivaśivaśiveti nāmani tava niravadhi nātha japyamāne 'smin | āsvādayan bhaveyaṃ kam api mahārasam apunaruktam

plain_english: In the vastness flashing as endless consciousness-self, where all dull paths are drunk up — may I roam Your worship, countless consciousness-made ramparts uncounted.
sanskrit_cite: sphuradanantacidātmakaviṣṭape parinipītasamastajaḍādhvani | agaṇitāparacinmayagaṇḍike pravicareyam ahaṃ bhavato 'rcitā

plain_english: For standing in self-body, clearly shining, eternal — nothing else is of use; firm be this thought — but the dust of Your pure feet.
sanskrit_cite: svavapuṣi sphuṭabhāsini śāśvate sthitikṛte na kim apy upayujyate | iti matiḥ sudṛḍhā bhavatāt paraṃ mama bhavaccaraṇābjarajaḥ śuceḥ

plain_english: Something flashes sometime in mind, touching Your feet — where this whole world melts — show it always, in the nectar-lake, Lord.
sanskrit_cite: kim api nātha kadācana cetasi sphurati tad bhavadaṃghritalaspṛśām | galati yatra samastamidaṃ sudhāsarasi viśvam idaṃ diśa me sadā
